about.text: A small round cheese made from sheep's milk, salt and rennet, Ġbejniet are prepared and served in a variety of forms. Until the early 20th century, ġbejniet made from unpasteurised milk were one of the causes of the spread of Brucellosis which was so prevalent as to be called "the Maltese fever".

facts.v: Shaped in a reed or plastic hurdle, then dried in small ventilated rooms with mesh-covered windows; firmer, nutty and musky
The peppered ones (tal-bżar) sharpen and turn crumbly with age; the salt-cured one is maħsula
